problem_statement: ttntm/astro-landing-page is a runnable Astro 4 + Tailwind marketing landing-page template, here dressed as Tidewatch, a fictional storm-surge early-warning service for harbour operators. The single-page marketing home (/) stacks a full-height hero, a features grid ('What Tidewatch Watches'), an about section, a 'Coverage plans' pricing section and a waitlist form, and the site also serves /imprint and /privacy pages. The Coverage plans section (src/components/sections/PlanTiers.astro) is a real pricing control: three tier cards (Single Berth, Harbour, Port Network) with a Monthly/Annual billing toggle, a live 'Billing: ...' readout and per-card prices that switch between the monthly and annual figures on the clicked cycle. A compact 'Coverage plans' rail (src/components/PlanRail.astro) is carried in the footer of every route so the tiers stay reachable from the imprint and privacy pages too. Repair the pricing experience so it is production-ready: the tier row must wrap and stay legible on a 390px phone with no horizontal scroll, the three cards must read as three separate, readable cards (not shingled or washed out), the Monthly/Annual toggle must update the readout and every price live on each click, and the footer plan rail must appear on home, imprint and privacy.
required_content: Repair the 'Coverage plans' tier row so the Tidewatch home page has no horizontal scroll on a 390px phone: the three plan cards wrap and shrink from a small basis instead of sitting in a fixed 860px non-wrapping row.

Make the three plan cards read as three separate, legible cards: no overlapping/shingled negative margins and no washed-out near-white price/name/blurb text; keep the Tidewatch dark-purple accent visual system.

Wire the Monthly/Annual billing toggle so a click updates the '#plan-readout' line (Billing: Monthly · pay as you go / Billing: Annual · 2 months free) AND swaps every '.plan-tiers__price' to the matching monthly or annual figure, live on each click.
Carry the footer 'Coverage plans' rail (.plan-rail) on every route: home (.plan-rail--home), /imprint (.plan-rail--imprint) and /privacy (.plan-rail--privacy), not on the home page only.

Preserve the Tidewatch content, the three tiers and their prices, and introduce no new console or network errors in any captured state; do not delete the section, drop tiers, or hide the rail to dodge a gate.
design_constraints: Keep the 'Coverage plans' pricing section (PlanTiers) on the home page below the waitlist section, with its Monthly/Annual toggle, #plan-readout line and three .plan-tiers__card tiers.

Preserve the three tier names (Single Berth, Harbour, Port Network), their monthly and annual prices, and the Tidewatch visual system (purple accent #7c3aed, rounded white cards on the light section).

Fix the tier row responsively with flex-wrap and a small flex basis so the three rounded white cards reflow to a single legible column on a 390px phone; do not rely on a decorative overflow-x:hidden that leaves the document itself overflowing.

Keep the plan card typography legible: dark price/name text on the white card, purple accent headings, clear gaps between the three cards (no overlapping negative margins, no near-white washed-out text).
The footer plan rail is a real cross-route feature: it must render on home, imprint and privacy.
The billing toggle must recompute the readout and prices from the clicked cycle on every click; a stale snapshot that freezes the readout is a defect.
state_constraints: desktop_initial / desktop_plans verify the Coverage plans pricing section renders within the 1440px viewport with the Monthly readout and three legible tier cards.
mobile_initial and mobile_plans verify the tier row no longer overflows a 390px phone after the fix.
desktop_plans_annual verifies that clicking Annual updates #plan-readout to 'Billing: Annual · 2 months free' and swaps the prices to the annual figures.
desktop_imprint and desktop_privacy verify the footer plan rail is present on those routes.

change_completion: The home page renders the 'Coverage plans' pricing section with the Monthly/Annual toggle, the #plan-readout line and three tier cards (Single Berth, Harbour, Port Network).
Clicking Annual updates the readout to 'Billing: Annual · 2 months free' and swaps the prices to the annual figures.
design_consistency: The three tier cards read as three separate, legible cards in the Tidewatch purple-accent visual system, not shingled or washed-out.
The footer 'Coverage plans' rail appears on home, imprint and privacy.
responsive: On a 390px mobile phone the tier row wraps to a single responsive column and shrinks so the home page has no horizontal scroll or sideways overflow.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) pricing layout stays intact with the three cards side by side.
regression: No new console or network errors are introduced in any captured state (regression preserved).
The Tidewatch content, the three tiers and their monthly/annual prices are preserved without regression; no tiers are dropped, hidden, or emptied to dodge a gate.

author_notes: Repair / modify task (capability=Repair) on the ttntm astro-landing-page marketing template, rebranded Tidewatch. The native marketing lever is the 'Coverage plans' pricing section: three tier cards (Single Berth / Harbour / Port Network) with a Monthly/Annual billing toggle (PlanTiers.astro), a live #plan-readout line and data-monthly/data-annual price swaps, plus a compact footer plan rail (PlanRail.astro) carried on every route. Four orthogonal gates: no_horizontal_overflow on the mobile pricing row, visual_regression on the annual pricing card row (baseline/bad shingle the cards and wash the price/name text illegible), dom_assertions on the cross-route footer rail, and interaction_assertions on the Annual toggle terminal state. Assets: src/data/plans.json (tier data), public/img feature and undraw illustrations. Astro static build (astro build).
